abstract: Upgrades an existing Gradle wrapper to a target version on Gradle 7.0 through 9.x. Orients first — confirms the wrapper is present and reads the declared version from gradle-wrapper.properties — then sources the target distribution's SHA-256 from gradle.org and runs the built-in wrapper task twice with the version and checksum pinned, so that gradlew, gradlew.bat, and gradle-wrapper.jar are regenerated from the new version's templates rather than the old ones. Explains the run-it-twice gotcha and the symptoms of a half-done upgrade, the checksum rules that apply once distributionSha256Sum is set, the version labels accepted by --gradle-version, and the Gradle 9 requirement that gradle-wrapper.properties declare a full X.Y.Z version. Distinguishes 'upgrade it' (execute) from 'how do I upgrade' (hand over the commands). Deliberately narrow: it does not add a wrapper to a project that has none, configure authenticated distributions, or customize the Wrapper task.
